Basics of morphology and pomology of fruit trees. (allowance 2/2)
Distribution of varieties of fruit trees according to cultivation characteristics and breeding goals. (allowance 2/2)
Pomological systems and development of the range of varieties of fruit species in the domestic and global environment. (allowance 2/2)
Basic principles and goals of breeding, selection and maintenance (preservation) of varieties of fruit species, gene pool collections. (allowance 2/2)
Pomological characteristics and development of the assortment of red stone fruit varieties. (allowance 2/2)
Pomological characteristics and development of the assortment of peach and nectarine varieties. (allowance 2/2)
Pomological characteristics and development of the assortment of strawberry varieties. (allowance 2/2)

The topics of the practices are correlated with the theory of the lectures, the students will get to know the morphology of the above-ground parts of fruit trees, the distribution of fruiting bodies of fruit trees, cutting of fruit species, cultivation systems and, last but not least, the basics of tasting evaluations. en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The content of the course is composed of the most important chapters of the broad issue of pomology of fruit species, which are mainly focused on the development of the assortment of varieties from history to the present, the division of varieties according to the purpose of fruit use, the characteristics of varieties with practical use and a basic view of the technology of growing fruit species.
